description: This file handles the removal of campaign-related email addresses or users from a mailing list, including opt-out processing and logging for the Campaigns module in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user object, retrieved and manipulated via BeanFactory.

classes.name: Campaign
classes.description: Represents campaign-related data, involved in email opt-out activities.

methods.name: clean_string
methods.description: Sanitizes input strings based on specified type.

methods.name: log_campaign_activity
methods.description: Logs campaign activities and returns activity details.

methods.name: return_module_language
methods.description: Loads language strings for a specific module.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes a user from a campaign.
